seven_q.Q0_posture: Analytical and critical; seeks to establish a structural isomorphism between physics and economics/theology
seven_q.Q1_identity: An isomorphism record (ISO-005) establishing a structural mapping between conservation of energy in physics and fiat currency in economics/theology
seven_q.Q2_domain: Interdisciplinary: physics (thermodynamics), economics (monetary theory), theology (moral order)
seven_q.Q3_claim: Fiat currency is structurally analogous to a conservation violation in physics, producing systemic degradation (inflation, inequality) analogous to waste heat and entropy increase
seven_q.Q4_support: Historical evidence of fiat currency failures (Roman denarius, Continental Dollar, Assignat, Reichsmark, Zimbabwe dollar); post-1971 economic data (CPI, Gini, debt-to-GDP); biblical prohibitions on false measures and theft
seven_q.Q5_dependencies: First Law of Thermodynamics; gold standard as conservation constraint; Nixon Shock as phase transition; Cantillon Effect; biblical economic ethics
seven_q.Q6_consequences: Predicts all fiat currencies will eventually fail; suggests restoration of conservation constraints (sound money) is necessary for systemic health; implies moral dimension to monetary policy
seven_q.Q7_kill: A stable fiat currency lasting over 100 years without productivity growth matching monetary expansion; demonstration that the mapping is too loose and applies to any input-output system

graph_summary.one_sentence: ISO-005 establishes a structural isomorphism between conservation of energy in physics and sound money in economics, arguing that fiat currency is a thermodynamic fraud that violates divine moral order.
